title: TSGF Autonomous Software Factory Skill Map

kinds.public: Command or skill triggered directly by the developer or orchestrator
kinds.lane: Autonomous worker lane dispatched by /tsgf run wave workflow
kinds.hook: Deterministic security guard enforcing safety constraints
kinds.board: State system (GitHub Project, config, ledgers, locks)
kinds.verb: Granular critique, audit, fix, and polish commands
kinds.advanced: TSGF exclusive capabilities beyond standard software factories

nodes.label: /tsgf
nodes.what: The master orchestrator: 5 verbs (onboard, lint, status, run, stop) taking the 7-column Kanban board (Backlog · Ready · Building · QA · Review · Blocked · Done) from empty to drained.
nodes.when: When you type /tsgf <verb>, start an autonomous wave, or check overall factory status.
nodes.how: The session acts strictly as an orchestrator: never implements product code directly. It coordinates wave planning, claims cards, dispatches isolated lane workers, and merges through the merge gate.
nodes.author: Gnanesh Balusa (gnanesh-16)

nodes.label: /tsgf run
nodes.what: The autonomous wave loop: repeatedly dispatches task waves from the Ready column until the board is drained or a halt gate fires.
nodes.when: When you run /tsgf run [slug] [--low|--high]. Also acts as the resume command after manual intervention.
nodes.how: Checks rate limit bucket with tsgf-gh-guard.sh, plans wave DAG with tsgf-wave-plan.py, claims cards by assignee, dispatches worker lanes, reconciles results, and reports progress.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf onboard
nodes.what: An 8-step setup wizard (System Checks · GitHub Remote · Project Board · Base Branch · AGENTS.md · Policies · Telemetry Sources · Review) that initializes and verifies repository settings.
nodes.when: When running /tsgf onboard on a new repo or to self-repair missing skills and guard hooks.
nodes.how: Executes tsgf-setup.py and tsgf-env-check.sh, verifies github connectivity, merges hook configurations into .claude/settings.json, and writes AGENTS.md managed blocks.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf lint
nodes.what: Pre-flight readiness auditor walking Ready cards to ensure parseable Acceptance Criteria, explicit dependencies, and scope limits before execution.
nodes.when: Run before starting a wave loop, especially after /tsgf-collect filed new backlog tickets.
nodes.how: Validates AC checklist syntax, enforces the <400 line PR cap, verifies blocker edges, and routes ambiguous cards for refinement.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf status
nodes.what: Read-only snapshot of the active configuration, all 7 Kanban columns in board order, and currently in-flight workers.
nodes.when: When running /tsgf status to inspect board and lane state without modifying anything.
nodes.how: Runs tsgf-status.py to read GitHub Project items or local board state and outputs a formatted table.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf stop
nodes.what: Graceful shutdown: safely stops the active wave, posts checkpoint status comments, releases card claims, and clears inflight locks.
nodes.when: When you run /tsgf stop or need to pause an autonomous loop.
nodes.how: Executes tsgf-stop.sh, signals worker processes cleanly, updates GitHub card assignees, and removes .claude/tsgf/inflight/ locks so the next run can resume.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf-collect
nodes.what: Signal collection engine: mines errors, user friction, and architectural debt from Sentry, PostHog, GitHub issues, and merged PRs, filing verified cards into Backlog.
nodes.when: When running /tsgf-collect or /tsgf-collect <sentry|posthog|issues|prs|architecture>.
nodes.how: Queries telemetry APIs, sends candidates to fresh verifier sub-agents, formats cards to TSGF ticket standard, deduplicates fingerprints, and files to Backlog.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /ui-refine-loop
nodes.what: Unattended critique-then-fix refinement loop polishing a frontend route or component to state-of-the-art aesthetics with Before | After evidence.
nodes.when: When running /ui-refine-loop <route|component> to polish UI styling, contrast, rhythm, and motion.
nodes.how: Runs iterative check-fix rounds: parallel critique & audit sub-agents rank typed problems, routed fix verbs apply changes, and a draft PR is opened.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /visual
nodes.what: Generates a self-contained, interactive single-page HTML report: branch recap, wave execution plan, or architecture diagram map.
nodes.when: When you run /visual recap, /visual plan, or /visual <path>.
nodes.how: Collects git diff facts and plan state, renders into an inline interactive HTML/CSS canvas template, and previews cleanly.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: /tsgf-sync
nodes.what: Safe git synchronization skill: groups changes into atomic semantic commits, merge-pulls upstream, and non-force pushes current branch.
nodes.when: When syncing code at the conclusion of a task.
nodes.how: Stages logical paths, validates secrets are excluded, enforces conventional commit headers, and protects against force-push hazards.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: tsgf-build
nodes.what: Lane 1 Builder: takes a Ready card into an isolated worktree, writes minimal safe diff test-first under the 400-line PR cap, opens draft PR, and moves card to QA.
nodes.when: Dispatched by the wave loop for Ready cards labelled bug or feature.
nodes.how: Spawns under .claude/worktrees/<id>, builds test-first using TDD, writes PR marker blocks via tsgf-pr-body.sh, and moves card to QA. Never merges.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: tsgf-qa
nodes.what: Lane 2 Tester: proves Acceptance Criteria with running tests, automated screenshots, and test-gap analysis. Passes card to Review or bounces back to Build.
nodes.when: Dispatched for cards in QA, and straight from Ready for 'qa'-labelled cards (which skip Building).
nodes.how: Runs project test commands, executes headless browser tests, captures full-page visual proof, updates PR visual blocks, and marks AC checkboxes.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: tsgf-review
nodes.what: Lane 3 Reviewer: conducts adversarial review, verifies historical review memory, validates project merge policies, and triggers the merge gate.
nodes.when: Dispatched for cards in Review that passed QA.
nodes.how: Forms independent hypotheses, audits diff against review memory ledger, verifies merge policy via tsgf-merge-policy.py, and merges through tsgf-merge-gate.sh.
nodes.author: TSGF Core

nodes.label: GitHub Project Board
nodes.what: The single source of truth: 7 columns (Backlog, Ready, Building, QA, Review, Blocked, Done) and 3 routing labels (qa, bug, feature).
nodes.when: Read and written on every wave by orchestrator and worker lanes.
nodes.how: Cards move via gh project item-edit; assignees act as worker mutexes; PR threads store lane audit comments.

nodes.label: tsgf config
nodes.what: Per-project JSON configuration storing board ID, base branch, verification commands, merge policy, model tier, and collection settings.
nodes.when: Written during /tsgf onboard; read at the start of every wave and lane run.
nodes.how: Stored at .claude/tsgf/config.json with active project pointer.

nodes.label: base branch
nodes.what: The target repository base branch (main/master/staging). Cards reach Done only when their merge commit lands on this branch.
nodes.when: Target of all worker PRs; updated only through atomic squash-merge gate.
nodes.how: Protected by guard-protected-push.py against direct or force pushes.

nodes.label: run manifest ledger
nodes.what: Per-run markdown ledger at docs/tsgf/runs/<date>.md recording every wave, card, execution duration, and final outcome.
nodes.when: Appended during each wave reconciliation phase.
nodes.how: Documents audit trail: | #N | lanesRun | finalStatus | column | detail |.

nodes.label: review memory ledger
nodes.what: Persistent memory of past review regressions, anti-patterns, and project smells stored at .claude/tsgf/review-memory.json.
nodes.when: Queried during Lane 3 Review pass to catch recurring architectural defects.
nodes.how: Updated whenever a reviewer identifies an antipattern or a PR is bounced.

nodes.label: taste file
nodes.what: Design taste and direction guide at docs/design/taste.md defining visual hierarchy, type scales, and color boundaries for ui-refine-loop.
nodes.when: Read by every critique, audit, and fix pass during UI refinement.
nodes.how: Records explicit user design preferences and anti-patterns to avoid.

nodes.label: Blocked · 🙋 Needs You
nodes.what: Card parked in Blocked requiring human action (money, credentials, destructive migration, or high risk diff).
nodes.when: Merge gate exits 7 (sensitive policy) or 8 (manual migration step).
nodes.how: Posts an explicit checklist comment; resumes when user comments 'done' or applies label.

nodes.label: guard-worktree-path
nodes.what: Denies git worktree add or move whose target directory escapes .claude/worktrees/ or .agents/worktrees/.
nodes.when: PreToolUse hook matching shell commands.
nodes.how: Resolves target path against repository boundaries and exits 1 if outside approved worktree dirs.

nodes.label: guard-secrets
nodes.what: Denies reading, cat-ing, or piping dotenv files, SSH private keys, .npmrc, or cloud credential JSON files.
nodes.when: PreToolUse hook on shell, read, and grep operations.
nodes.how: Regex matches file targets against sensitive credential formats and blocks unauthorized reads.

nodes.label: guard-key-literals
nodes.what: Scans file edits and writes for live high-entropy API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, Stripe) and rejects changes.
nodes.when: PreToolUse on file edit, write, and patch tools.
nodes.how: Runs token entropy and prefix detection; reports line numbers of detected secrets without leaking values.

nodes.label: guard-delete-outside
nodes.what: Denies rm, rmdir, find -delete, or git clean targeting outside repository root, /, or ~.
nodes.when: PreToolUse hook on shell command execution.
nodes.how: Canonicalizes paths and blocks destructive commands outside project boundaries.

nodes.label: guard-protected-push
nodes.what: Blocks direct or force git push commands to main, master, or configured base branches.
nodes.when: PreToolUse hook on git push operations.
nodes.how: Inspects git push refspecs and active branch; requires PR workflow for all mainline code.

nodes.label: cleanup-wt
nodes.what: Prunes worktrees and local branches already merged into base branch; writes audit log to recovery.json.
nodes.when: Triggered post-merge by the merge gate and at session start.
nodes.how: Validates git ancestry before removal; never deletes unmerged branches.

nodes.label: tsgf-wave-plan.py
nodes.what: Dependency graph solver computing wave concurrency: parses 'Blocked by' edges, prioritizes bugs, and routes qa cards.
nodes.when: Called at the start of every wave iteration.
nodes.how: Builds directed acyclic graph of Ready cards, checks inflight locks, and returns eligible card batches.

nodes.label: tsgf-merge-gate.sh
nodes.what: The atomic gate to the base branch: locks repo, re-proves test suites, validates merge policy, and squash-merges.
nodes.when: Called by Lane 3 Reviewer once review passes.
nodes.how: Takes mkdir atomic lock, proves HEAD against target, evaluates tsgf-merge-policy.py, runs allowed migrations, and squash-merges.

nodes.label: tsgf-pr-body.sh
nodes.what: Surgical PR body reader/writer updating individual marker blocks (status, problem, solution, ac, history, visual, risk).
nodes.when: Used by Build, QA, and Review lanes to update their sections without clobbering other lanes.
nodes.how: Replaces content between HTML comment markers <!-- tsgf:<block>:begin --> and <!-- tsgf:<block>:end -->.

nodes.label: tsgf-gh-guard.sh
nodes.what: Rate-limit token-bucket protection preventing GitHub CLI rate limit lockouts during autonomous runs.
nodes.when: Wraps all gh API calls across orchestrator and lane scripts.
nodes.how: Checks rate_limit remaining; pauses execution before hitting quota exhaustion.

nodes.label: Multi-Host Engine
nodes.what: Native cross-runtime interoperability supporting Antigravity IDE, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Cursor from a single unified .agents/ infrastructure.
nodes.when: Zero-friction agent switching across developer environments.
nodes.how: Maintains canonical skills, scripts, and workflows in .agents/ and dynamically establishes host symlinks (.claude/, .codex/).

nodes.label: Auto-Remediation Feedback
nodes.what: Self-healing closed feedback loop: failing QA tests or Review requests bounce the card back to Building with structured diff-level failure context.
nodes.when: Triggered whenever test assertions fail or reviewer flags architectural debt.
nodes.how: Annotates PR with failure diagnosis, returns card to Building lane, and re-triggers isolated worktree fix cycle automatically.

nodes.label: Visual Proof Engine
nodes.what: Automated headless browser screenshot capture across light/dark themes and responsive breakpoints, attached directly to PR visual blocks.
nodes.when: Executed by Lane 2 (tsgf-qa) for UI components and routes.
nodes.how: Captures full-page and crop screenshots pinned to commit SHA, rendering Before/After visual comparison sheets.

nodes.label: tdd
nodes.what: Test-driven development discipline: public interface tests, red before green, one vertical slice at a time.
nodes.when: Followed by tsgf-build for every feature and bug ticket.
nodes.how: Writes failing test first, writes minimal implementation to pass, then refactors under green test coverage.

nodes.label: diagnosing-bugs
nodes.what: Scientific root cause diagnosis: tight reproduction feedback loop, hypothesis formulation, and regression test.
nodes.when: Reached by tsgf-build on bug-labelled cards and by tsgf-qa on test failures.
nodes.how: Requires reproducing command before theorizing; hands off to implementation with reproducible test case.

nodes.label: code-review
nodes.what: Two-axis code inspection: Standards (repo architectural rules & Fowler smells) and Spec (verifying acceptance criteria).
nodes.when: Run by tsgf-build against its own diff and by tsgf-review for merge approval.
nodes.how: Evaluates diff against merge base, flags architectural debt, and checks historical regression memory.

nodes.label: critique
nodes.what: UX design assessment scored /20 across specificity, visual hierarchy, typography, color harmony, and composition.
nodes.when: Run by ui-refine-loop on UI route screenshots.
nodes.how: Inspects desktop/mobile screenshots in light/dark mode and produces ranked findings.

nodes.label: audit
nodes.what: Technical frontend audit scored /20 across accessibility (a11y), responsive layout, performance, and code integrity.
nodes.when: Run by ui-refine-loop in parallel with design critique.
nodes.how: Audits DOM semantics, color contrast, and layout shift indicators.

nodes.label: polish
nodes.what: Final aesthetic pass over touched files correcting subtle micro-spacing, alignment inconsistencies, and token usage.
nodes.when: Always the concluding step of every UI refinement fix round.
nodes.how: Polishes touched code without making structural changes.

views.title: TSGF Autonomous Software Factory Overview
views.caption: Collect telemetry into Backlog; the Orchestrator drains Ready through Build → QA → Review; automated merge gate lands PRs onto the base branch.

views.title: Master Orchestrator (/tsgf)
views.caption: The 5 orchestrator verbs coordinating board state, wave planning, project onboarding, and graceful termination.

views.title: Worker Lanes (Build → QA → Review)
views.caption: Isolated lane workers: minimal safe diffs under 400 lines, Acceptance Criteria runtime verification with screenshot proof, and adversarial review.

views.title: Deterministic Safety & Guard Hooks
views.caption: Python stdlib guards enforcing worktree containment, credential privacy, secret redaction, and branch protection.

views.title: TSGF Exclusive Innovations
views.caption: Next-generation capabilities beyond traditional software factories: multi-host interoperability, closed-loop auto-remediation, visual proof sheets, and review memory.
